summary: Enterprise healthcare-payments contact center evaluating Redwood Private for agent-assist, ticket summarization, and reliable tool-calling under billing-cycle spikes. Primary constraints: PCI+HIPAA compliance, VPC/on-prem deployment, long-term audit logs and retention. Decision motivated by need for deterministic latency during high concurrency and vendor ability to produce attestation artifacts.
detailed_requirements: Latency SLO: suggestion latency median <200ms, p95 <500ms under 3k concurrent agents during peak billing windows.
Throughput: support burst to 10k reqs/min for batch summarization jobs at month-end without violating latency SLO for live agents.
Model controls: must support explicit model pinning, canary rollouts, and automated fallback to smaller quantized variant when capacity constrained.
Data controls: no uncontrolled egress of raw card numbers or PHI; KMS-backed encryption at rest; audit logs immutable for 7+ years.
Integrations: SSO/SAML, SCIM, Genesys connector, out-of-band webhook for tool-calling to internal ticketing API.
Compliance deliverables requested: PCI-DSS scoping memo, HIPAA BA agreement template, SOC2 type II report (or equivalent) and network topology for VPC deployment.
